title: wg: ext-10 §6.2.2 backslash lost; parameter_value charset undefined
description: Erratum and suggestion. L1060 'the first escaping backslash ("") is omitted' (backslash also missing in the XML source, L810). The text references RFC 2045 quoted-string (L1074) and RFC 5322 (L1820) but never says which octets parameter_value may contain (NUL, CR/LF). mimid allows RFC 5322 VCHAR/WSP (decision mimid-1wgh.3.33). Fix: restore the backslash and state the repertoire.
notes:
Source has the backslash; kramdown treats \" as an escape and drops it. Fix: ("\\") or a code span.

Verified 2026-10-18: backslash CONFIRMED (main .md L811 '("\")' dropped by kramdown); editorial PR. Charset PARTLY: RFC 2045 quoted-string reference already pins US-ASCII; missing is an explicit statement and whether CTLs (NUL/CR/LF) are allowed. Normative choice, so file as an issue. Not raised.

Sent 2026-10-18: backslash in PR https://github.com/mlswg/mls-extensions/pull/106; charset issue https://github.com/mlswg/mls-extensions/issues/107
